title: R&D Project Manager
description:
We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence \- and questions into answers.
   

  

 If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world\-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role is based in the Pune R\&D Center, at SAS R\&D Pune facility. The candidate will work as a Project Manager for products that are part Foundation SAS. As a Project Manager, candidate will be responsible for all aspects of project management: the direction, planning and estimation, coordination, implementation, execution, and completion of specific projects while ensuring consistency with SAS’ overall strategy, commitments, and goals.
   

  

 Experience: 10\-15 Years
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Proven ability to lead end\-to\-end project management across planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery.
* Capability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while meeting deadlines and quality expectations.
* Expertise in Agile methodologies with hands\-on experience driving Agile project execution and continuous delivery.
* Ability to lead CI/CD\-oriented project teams and align delivery with organizational strategy and goals.
* Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to influence without direct authority and drive consensus across cross\-functional teams.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for project outcomes, ensuring commitments are met with high quality and reliability.
* Ability to take proactive decisions, escalate risks appropriately, and ensure closure of action items.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, including expectation setting, conflict resolution, and negotiation.
* Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to present effectively to diverse audiences.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with local and global teams across different time zones.
* Ability to manage project risks, including identification, mitigation planning, and proactive escalation.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities to evaluate complex scenarios and derive effective solutions.
* Strong focus on quality improvement, including identifying gaps, recommending solutions, and implementing process enhancements.
* Experience in driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction.
* Ability to design, standardize, and optimize project management processes and workflows
* Has PMP \& CSM (or equivalent) certifications. Has undergone Agile trainings
* Excellent negotiation, facilitation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to perform well under pressure; ability to adhere to deadlines
* Ability to perform well under pressure; ability to adhere to deadlines
* Ability to give attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to travel as needed
* An excellent listener who absorbs and respects opinions of others, but is decisive and able to influence, with and without direct authority
* Ability to work closely with remote and local teams
* Hands\-on experience with project management and collaboration tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and Cloud Jira environments.
* Familiarity with modern DevOps ecosystems, CI/CD pipelines, and project tracking tools.
* Understanding of digital transformation initiatives and adoption of cloud\-based tools
* Ability to manage budgeting process and analyze budget performance is desirable
* Accounting, maths and analytical skills are desirable


**Primary Responsibilities**
* Supports R\&D Engineering teams in completing deadline\-driven, team\-based projects. Responsible for facilitating overall project objectives, goals and project requirements. Works with team and stakeholders to define project scope and goals.Plans, prioritizes, implements and adjusts delivery schedule, scope, resourcing, and quality, based on individual project requirements per consultation with project stakeholders.
* Works with management to identify resource needs and coordinate technical resources for assigned projects, including both domestic and international resources. Maintains project documentation such as project plans, schedules, issue lists, risk registers, and status reports.
* Coordinates, communicates, and facilitates activities between team members and stakeholders to keep projects on schedule and manage conflict. Coordinates risk mitigation activity and escalates as appropriate. Manages project scope and expectations. Identifies and constructively negotiates conflicts or areas of high risk
* Leverages methodologies, processes, project tools, and best practices to accelerate project delivery.
* Identifies project dependencies and stakeholder influences, working jointly with other organizations who share responsibility for delivery of final product. Acts as central point of contact and interfaces with interested parties across the Company, such as Legal, Marketing and SAS.com to ensure project success.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Manages multiple small to medium scale projects independently with minimal supervision using existing methods and procedures on new assignments.
* Suggests and influences changes to methods and procedures.
* Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise.
* Trains end\-users in new products, solutions and/or processes
* Sphere of influence: immediate co\-workers/team members
* Note: This job is the fully qualified, career\-oriented, journey\-level position.


**You are welcome here.**
 At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Samal Constructions Pvt. Ltd. has been delivering high\-value construction projects since 1963, with a strong reputation for quality and reliability. The company specializes in industrial facilities, luxury bungalows, corporate offices, institutional buildings, residential complexes, commercial spaces, and healthcare projects. With decades of experience, Samal Constructions manages complex, large\-scale developments while maintaining high standards of safety and workmanship. The organization offers professionals the opportunity to work on diverse, technically challenging projects and grow within a stable, well\-established company.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Project Manager will oversee end\-to\-end project delivery, ensuring construction projects are completed on time, within budget, and to quality and safety standards. This full\-time hybrid role is based in the Pune Division, with primary on\-site responsibilities and some flexibility for work\-from\-home tasks such as planning, documentation, and coordination. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include project planning and scheduling, resource allocation, coordinating with clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers, and monitoring progress against milestones. The Project Manager will supervise site teams, manage risk and issue resolution, oversee inspections and compliance, and ensure effective logistics and material management. The role also involves regular reporting to senior leadership, cost control, and continuous improvement of project execution practices.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Project Management skills, including planning, scheduling, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
* Candidates should possess Expeditor and Expediting skills to track materials, follow up with vendors, and ensure timely delivery of critical items.
* Candidates should possess Inspection skills to verify work quality, safety compliance, and adherence to design and regulatory standards.
* Candidates should possess Logistics Management skills to manage material flow, site deliveries, storage, and resource allocation efficiently.
* Relevant qualifications such as a degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field are preferred.
* Experience managing medium to large construction projects, ideally across industrial, residential, or commercial sectors, is highly beneficial.
* Proficiency in project management and scheduling software, strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, and effective communication skills are expected.
* Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, collaborate with diverse stakeholders, and maintain high standards of safety and quality is essential.

title: Program Mananger - ERP Implementation
description:
Zycus is seeking a Program Manager – Implementation to lead end\-to\-end enterprise SaaS / ERP implementations for global customers. The ideal candidate will have proven experience managing complex digital transformation programs across ERP, supply chain, procurement, finance, HR tech, CRM, or other enterprise technology platforms.
 



  





 We are specifically seeking professionals with an
 **AI\-first mindset** 
 who embrace innovation, continuously explore emerging technologies, and can effectively integrate AI\-driven approaches into enterprise implementation and transformation programs.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in program governance, stakeholder management, risk management, and change management strategies, particularly for large\-scale global rollouts and enterprise transformation initiatives.
 



  





 We are looking for AI\-first and innovation\-driven professionals who are passionate about leveraging Artificial Intelligence, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies to transform enterprise implementation and delivery experiences. The candidate should demonstrate adaptability toward AI\-enabled ways of working and possess a continuous learning mindset in the evolving enterprise technology landscape.
 



  





 Role \& Responsibilities
 



  




* Lead and oversee end\-to\-end implementation programs for Zycus enterprise SaaS solutions across global customers.
* Drive successful execution of multiple enterprise implementation projects across diverse industry verticals and geographical regions.
* Conduct project kick\-off meetings to establish objectives, scope, deliverables, governance structure, and customer expectations.
* Track project progress and ensure timely delivery by managing scope, timelines, cost, quality, dependencies, and change requests.

* Ensure efficient resource planning and cross\-functional collaboration for successful project delivery.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives within Professional Services by implementing best practices, delivery excellence frameworks, and operational optimization programs.
* Drive AI\-first implementation and delivery practices by leveraging intelligent automation, analytics, AI copilots, and modern collaboration tools to improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and project governance.
* Partner with internal product, delivery, and innovation teams to identify opportunities for AI\-led process optimization and implementation acceleration.
* Promote a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement by encouraging adoption of AI\-powered tools, automation frameworks, and data\-driven decision\-making practices.
* Leverage AI\-enabled project management approaches for risk identification, status reporting, resource optimization, and delivery insights.
* Foster a collaborative and innovation\-driven culture by enabling brainstorming sessions and encouraging new ideas and process improvements.
* Travel periodically to customer locations for project discussions, workshops, requirements gathering, executive reviews, and implementation planning.
* Mentor and guide project teams through regular coaching, one\-on\-one discussions, and delivery reviews to ensure high performance and continuous learning.



  





 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



  




* 10–15 years of proven experience in program management and enterprise project delivery within SaaS, cloud, ERP, or digital transformation environments.
* Strong experience managing end\-to\-end implementations for enterprise/global customers.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, GEP, JAGGAER, JD Edwards, or similar enterprise SaaS/ERP applications.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies, governance models, implementation frameworks, and delivery best practices.
* Proven expertise in risk management, escalation management, and change management for enterprise transformation programs.
* Strong AI\-first mindset with curiosity and adaptability toward emerging technologies, intelligent automation, generative AI, AI copilots, and modern digital transformation practices.
* Experience using AI\-powered productivity, collaboration, analytics, or project management tools to improve delivery effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated ability to drive innovation and process transformation using automation and AI\-enabled approaches within enterprise delivery environments.
* Awareness of evolving enterprise AI trends and their impact on SaaS implementation, customer success, and digital transformation programs.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex projects in a fast\-paced global environment.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams and international customers.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* PMP, Agile, PRINCE2, Scrum, or similar certifications will be preferred.



  





 Preferred Experience
 



  




* Experience in procurement, supply chain, finance, HR tech, CRM, ITSM, or other enterprise transformation domains will be considered an advantage, but is not mandatory.
* Experience working in SaaS product organizations or enterprise cloud transformation programs is highly preferred.
* Candidates demonstrating proactive adoption of AI tools, automation\-led thinking, digital innovation initiatives, or AI\-enabled delivery practices will be strongly preferred.
* Exposure to AI\-led transformation initiatives, intelligent automation, or digital innovation programs will be a strong advantage.



  





**Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune** 




  





 Why You Should Join Zycus?
 



  





**Work with leading global enterprises to drive digital and AI\-led procurement transformation.** 



* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS organization at the forefront of AI innovation in procurement.
* Thrive in a collaborative, high\-impact, and innovation\-driven environment.
* Opportunity to shape next\-generation intelligent procurement solutions.

title: Associate Director_3367
description:
**About The Job**

It runs four pillars, Personal Productivity, AI\-Native Ways of Working, Application Rebuild \& Modernization, and AI Use Case Delivery, on top of a shared AI platform ecosystem that provides the runtime, governance, observability, and reusable building blocks every solution runs on.
   

  

 The AI Factory Lead India will head the AI Factory's India team members in India: AI Engagement Managers who shape and steer OE engagements, Forward Deployed Engineers who build and ship the underlying solutions, and AI Platform Engineers who build and operate the shared AI platform every solution runs on. Together they turn OE and Group pain points into deliverable, funded AI projects through a defined lifecycle from Idea to Handover, backed by a growing library of reusable AI building blocks that turn one OE's solution into the next OE's head start. The AI Factory Lead India will also bridge the end\-to\-end delivery, setting priorities across concurrent engagements, growing and coaching AI Engagement Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and AI Platform Engineers, and acting as the senior escalation point with AI Factory, Allianz Technology leadership, Heads of ITs', and Account Managers. The role balances demand shaping and delivery execution with platform health, and represents the India team within Allianz Technology's global AI Factory leadership.
   

  

**What You Do**
* Lead and grow the India AI Factory team \- AI Engagement Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and AI Platform Engineers and other AI roles \- setting priorities across concurrent OE engagements.
* Coach and develop team members; manage workload distribution, performance, hiring, and career growth across all three disciplines.
* Own the Factory's India delivery portfolio: sequence engagements, resolve cross\-team resource conflicts, and ensure reusable patterns (MVS, AI Building Blocks, platform capabilities) flow between projects.
* Act as the senior escalation point and relationship owner with OE leadership, Heads of IT, and Account Managers, unblocking engagements Engagement Managers cannot resolve alone.
* Own the India team's overall demand pipeline; prioritize opportunities, allocate Engagement Managers, and balance qualification, delivery, and run\-support work across concurrent engagements.
* Represent the AI Factory in governance forums, portfolio reviews, and budget and resourcing conversations with senior stakeholders, up to CTO and Board level where required.
* Ensure the AI Platform Engineers' roadmap (runtime, governance, FinOps, observability) reflects needs surfaced by live engagements.
* Champion reuse: ensure Forward Deployed Engineers contribute new patterns back to the central building\-block catalogue and Engagement Managers factor reuse into scoping.
* Own the build\-to\-run handover model \- including support models, SLAs/OLAs, runbooks, and MLOps/monitoring \- and maintain oversight of security, compliance, and responsible\-AI standards across all Factory deliverables.
* Track Factory\-wide KPIs (time\-to\-value, reuse rate, delivery predictability, platform cost and reliability) and drive continuous improvement.


**What You Bring**
* Proven experience leading multi\-disciplinary technical teams (delivery/engagement, engineering, and platform functions) in large, matrix organizations, ideally in insurance or another regulated environment; knowledge of Allianz Group and Allianz Technology is a plus.
* People management track record: hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development across senior technical and delivery roles.
* Senior enough for OE leadership and Head of IT conversations, technical enough to challenge scope and platform decisions honestly.
* Strong stakeholder, business\-framing, and roadmap\-shaping skills, with the ability to prepare clear decision materials for executive audiences.
* Experience running a delivery portfolio: demand shaping, prioritization, resourcing, budget ownership, and risk management across concurrent engagements.
* An entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable taking ownership and driving topics forward in a build\-up environment without waiting for perfect structure.
* A degree in business, management, technology, or a related field.
* Fluent in English.


 Not Expected To Hands\-on Build Or Hold Formal Certifications (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman) \- Working Knowledge Of The Following Is Needed To Guide Trade\-offs, Hold Credible Technical Conversations With The Team, And Challenge Or Support Architectural And Platform Decisions
   

  

* Enterprise and solution architecture concepts \- technical blueprints, reusable solution frameworks, AI reference architectures, and integration standards.
* GenAI\-enabled capabilities such as intelligent assistants, copilots, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agents, and automation pipelines.
* Architecture patterns for multi\-system integration, API orchestration, and data harmonization.
* Cloud\-native platforms and services on at least one major hyperscaler (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* The modern AI/data stack \- vector databases, embedding stores, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and LLM/agent framework integration.
* AI governance and responsible\-AI principles, including model governance, data lineage, and auditability.
* Solution lifecycle management and reuse practices (MVS, AI Building Blocks) across sandbox, standardization, and retirement stages.


**What We Offer**
* We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in\-person collaboration and remote working, including up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
* We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
* From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
* Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.

 With its headquarters in Munich, Germany, Allianz Technology is Allianz's global IT service provider and delivers IT solutions that drive the group's digitalization. With more than 11,000 employees in over 20 countries around the world, Allianz Technology is tasked with running, optimizing, transforming, and innovating the infrastructure, applications, and services together with Allianz companies to co\-create the best customer experience.
   

  

 We service the entire spectrum of digitalization, from one of the industry's largest IT infrastructure projects that spans data centres, networks, and security, to application platforms ranging from workplace services to digital interaction. In short: We deliver comprehensive end\-to\-end IT solutions for Allianz in the digital age. We are the backbone of Allianz. Find us at: www.linkedin.com/company/allianz\-technology.

title: Demand Planning and Supply Chain Lead
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Procurement Management** 



* Take over manufacturer/vendor coordination after NPD finalizes the product, costing, and first product details.
* Release purchase orders and maintain accurate PO trackers.
* Coordinate with vendors for production timelines, dispatch timelines, quantities, and delivery commitments.
* Manage repeat orders and future PO processing based on inventory requirements.
* Coordinate on MOQ, delivery timelines, payment terms, and commercial terms where required.
* Track vendor\-wise lead times, production capacity, and delivery adherence.
* Escalate vendor delays, short supply, quality issues, cost changes, or documentation gaps on time.
* Work with Finance for payment planning and working capital alignment.



**2\. Inventory Planning** 



* Maintain SKU\-wise and platform\-wise inventory plans across brands and channels.
* Track current stock, in\-transit stock, platform stock, 3PL stock, blocked stock, and available stock.
* Monitor inventory days at SKU, brand, platform, and company level.
* Maintain target inventory days around 60 days, adjusted by SKU type, lead time, MOQ, sales velocity, and campaign plans.
* Track 7\-day, 15\-day, and 30\-day average sales velocity for important SKUs.
* Predict expected stockout dates and raise reorder alerts before risk becomes urgent.
* Prepare reorder plans based on sales velocity, lead time, safety stock, vendor timelines, and platform inward timelines.
* Identify excess stock, slow\-moving stock, dead stock, and inventory above 60/90 days.
* Prepare purchase priority lists based on sales, margin, stockout risk, campaign importance, and cash flow.



**3\. Fulfilment \& Platform Delivery** 



* Plan timely pickup of stock from manufacturers/vendors.
* Coordinate with transporters, 3PLs, platform teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure stock reaches the correct warehouse, 3PL, or platform on time.
* Manage Amazon, Flipkart, Quick Commerce, D2C, MT, GT, and other platform replenishment requirements.
* Own appointment booking and appointment follow\-ups for platform deliveries.
* Track dispatch date, delivery date, GRN/inward date, and live stock date.
* Ensure stock is not only dispatched but also inwarded and available for sale.
* Track delayed appointments, rejected shipments, short deliveries, damaged deliveries, and pending GRNs.
* Coordinate inter\-warehouse stock transfers where required.



**4\. NPD to Supply Chain Handover** 




 The Supply Chain Lead must ensure that every new product handover includes: 
 


* Final vendor/manufacturer details, final approved costing, MOQ, lead time, payment terms, and production timeline.
* Final product specifications, packaging specifications, product dimensions, weight, barcode/MRP, and batch details.
* Shelf life and expiry details wherever applicable.
* QC checklist, first PO recommendation, expected launch date, initial inventory requirement, and platform\-wise launch stock plan.
* No PO should be released unless the NPD handover is complete.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate should not be only a procurement person or only a dispatch coordinator. This person should understand the full supply chain cycle and be able to connect vendor timelines, inventory days, platform stock, appointments, cash flow, and sales impact. 
 



**The person should think like a planner, execute like an operator, and follow up like an owner.**

* Utilize Market Risk Analyzer and Credit Risk Analyzer to mitigate financial risks.
* Prepare functional gaps analysis by identifying areas where standard SAP S4 HANA TRM functionalities need enhancements or customization
* Handle complex enhancements in TRM requirements, ensuring the solution aligns with the client's business requirements.

* Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the senior manager.

* You’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse business requirements independently (Mandatory skill)

* Must be able to prepare the materials for the design workshops independently (Mandatory skill)
* Must send out the Meeting Minutes of the Workshop post each workshop that he/she leads (Mandatory skill)
* Follow up on the action items from the workshops
* Advanced knowledge and experience with SAP S4 HANA TRM Module.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills, coupled with a strong interest in further developing and integrating enterprise domain knowledge with technology skills.


**What We Look For**
* Candidate must be a qualified CA / ICWA / MBA Finance/M. Com in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience between 7 to 11years
* Must have at least 2 end\-to\-end implementation experience and strong hands\-on experience in SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) module.
* Proficiency in S/4HANA Finance with a focus on Treasury, Cash, and Liquidity Management
* Experience in Cash Management, Bank Communication Management (BCM), and In\-House Cash (IHC)
* Good understanding of Credit Risk, financial instruments, and exposure management.
* Familiarity and Hands on experience with SAP FICO concepts, including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting.
* Knowledge of integration with FI, CO, MM, and external banking systems.
* Candidate should be capable to understand the existing Legacy as\-is application \& business set up and implement in SAP all the sub\-modules of SAP treasury.
* Should participate in BPP workshops, design \& implement solutions in SAP.
* Should provide architectural suggestions on set up and integration between existing SAP \& non\-SAP systems.
* Should be able to lead a team of functional \& technical consultants.
* Should be able to draw up proposals \& plans for the project.
* SAP Certification in Treasury and Risk Management is preferable
* Should be good in Communication both written and verbal

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Sr Operation Manager Wedding
description:
**Role: Wedding Operations Manager** 




**Company:** 
 Benchmark Marcom Pvt Ltd
 



**Location:** 
 Pune (with extensive travel as required)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 







  





**Role Overview** 




 This role is the backbone of execution.
 



 As the Wedding Operations Manager, you are responsible for translating plans and designs into flawless on\-ground reality. You own logistics, timelines, vendor coordination, manpower, and problem\-solving across all wedding events.
 



 This is not a desk role. It requires presence, decisiveness, and the ability to stay composed while managing complexity, scale, and pressure.
 



 You are the person who ensures that what was promised is delivered—quietly, efficiently, and without drama.
 







  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Event Operations \& Execution** 



* Own end\-to\-end operational planning for all wedding events
* Create detailed event\-wise execution timelines and run\-of\-show documents
* Ensure smooth setup, transitions, and breakdowns across events
* Anticipate operational risks and plan contingencies in advance



**2\. Vendor \& Partner Management** 



* Coordinate with all vendors: decor, production, lighting, sound, hospitality, logistics, security, artists, and venues
* Share clear timelines, layouts, and expectations with each vendor
* Monitor vendor performance and adherence to timelines and scope
* Handle on\-ground negotiations, issue resolution, and last\-minute adjustments



**3\. Team \& Manpower Management** 



* Plan and deploy on\-ground teams effectively
* Assign clear roles and responsibilities to coordinators and staff
* Ensure team discipline, punctuality, and alignment
* Act as the central command point during events



**4\. Budget \& Resource Control** 



* Ensure execution stays aligned with approved budgets
* Track scope changes and flag cost implications early
* Minimise wastage through smart planning and reuse
* Coordinate with planning and accounts teams on reconciliations



**5\. Client \& Internal Coordination** 



* Work closely with Client Service, Planning, and Design teams
* Ensure client\-approved plans are executed accurately
* Shield clients from operational stress during events
* Communicate calmly and clearly during high\-pressure moments



**6\. On\-Ground Crisis Management** 



* Handle unexpected issues decisively (weather, delays, vendor failures, guest\-related challenges)
* Make quick, practical decisions without escalating panic
* Maintain control and clarity in chaotic situations







  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 4\-6 years of experience in wedding operations, large\-scale events, or hospitality operations
* Strong understanding of Indian weddings and multi\-day event formats
* Proven ability to manage large teams and multiple vendors
* Excellent logistical and organisational skills
* Comfort working long hours during event periods



**Good to Have** 



* Experience with destination weddings
* Exposure to luxury or high\-end events
* Understanding of production, staging, and technical setups
* Ability to read layouts, drawings, and spatial plans







  





**Skills \& Traits We Value** 



* Calm under pressure
* Decisive and solution\-oriented
* Highly organised
* Strong leadership presence
* Clear communicator
* Physically and mentally resilient







  





**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 



* Events run on time with minimal visible stress
* Vendors perform efficiently and responsibly
* Clients experience smooth, confident execution
* Issues are resolved before they escalate
* Planning and design intent is protected on ground







  





**Working Style \& Culture Fit** 



* This is a high\-ownership role
* Requires authority, accountability, and maturity
* Not reactive firefighting; structured operations are expected
* You will be trusted to make decisions independently







  





**Compensation** 



* Competitive fixed salary based on experience
* Performance\-linked incentives per project
* Growth opportunity into Head of Operations roles

description:

**Senior Lead, Anaplan Solutions \& Planning Platforms** 
  

  

*Job Description \| Finance Technology*
**Position Summary** 
  

  

 We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated
 **Senior Lead, Anaplan Solutions \& Planning Platforms** 
 to lead the implementation, support, and strategic expansion of enterprise planning solutions across Finance. This role will own delivery outcomes across Anaplan Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR support, Income Statement planning, Data Hub architecture, integrations, UX reporting, and future planning modernization capabilities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is not only a strong Anaplan expert, but also a capability builder who can establish delivery discipline, mentor a team, strengthen governance, and translate business priorities into scalable, controlled, and user\-friendly planning solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Required Technical Skills \& Experience
* Deep expertise in Anaplan solution architecture, model building, Data Hub design, ALM, UX development, and deployment management, with a proven ability to design scalable, high\-performing enterprise planning solutions.
* Strong functional knowledge of FP\&A, workforce planning, budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and financial data management, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable planning capabilities.
* Experience leading end\-to\-end implementation and enhancement of enterprise planning platforms, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, governance, and production support.
* Proven ability to design and manage enterprise data integrations, leveraging APIs, SQL, and data analysis techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and timely availability across planning ecosystems.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills with expertise in reporting, analytics, controls, access management, documentation, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling, complemented by experience working within Agile delivery frameworks and modern Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams, influence stakeholders, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning efficiency, data quality, and business outcomes.
* Leadership \& Team Development
* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing Anaplan delivery team comprising model builders, analysts, engineers, and solution SMEs.
* Establish clear ways of working across backlog management, sprint execution, release planning, quality reviews, documentation, and production support.
* Coach team members on Anaplan best practices, model design, data management, performance optimization, and business engagement.
* Create a sustainable capability model with role clarity, cross\-training, succession planning, and measurable skill maturity.
* Strategy, Roadmap \& Stakeholder Management
* Partner with Finance, FP\&A, HR, Risk, Corporate Functions, and Technology stakeholders to define priorities, business outcomes, and delivery roadmap.
* Translate business needs into scalable Anaplan solutions that improve forecasting, workforce planning, scenario analysis, expense planning, and management reporting.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders by providing clear options, risks, dependencies, trade\-offs, and recommendations.
* Lead prioritization forums and drive alignment across business value, regulatory needs, capacity, and technical feasibility.
* Solution Architecture \& Delivery Ownership
* Own end\-to\-end design and delivery of enterprise Anaplan capabilities across Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR, Income Statement planning, cost center planning, and scenario modeling.
* Design scalable multi\-model architectures using Data Hub, ALM, controlled data flows, modular design principles, and reusable planning components.
* Ensure models are performant, auditable, maintainable, secure, and aligned to Anaplan and enterprise technology standards.
* Oversee requirements, design, build, testing, UAT, deployment, documentation, and post\-production stabilization.
* Platform Operations, Controls \& Data Quality
* Strengthen production support, incident management, release governance, access controls, and operational risk management.
* Establish data validation, reconciliation, completeness checks, and error\-handling processes across inbound and outbound planning data.
* Drive improvements in platform stability, data accuracy, business adoption, user experience, and planning cycle efficiency.
* Maintain strong documentation for model architecture, data lineage, integrations, controls, release records, and support procedures.


  

  

* Innovation \& Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to simplify planning processes, automate manual activities, enhance reporting visibility, and improve self\-service capability.
* Evaluate and apply modern planning practices including predictive planning, advanced analytics, AI\-enabled insights, and integration automation where appropriate.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, operational precision, accountability, and business\-value driven delivery.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise planning, financial systems, EPM platforms, FP\&A technology, or related finance technology domains.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on Anaplan implementation, model building, and solution architecture experience.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-scale planning implementations from concept through production deployment.
* Strong working knowledge of FP\&A, forecasting, budgeting, workforce planning, management reporting, cost center planning, and financial data structures.
* Anaplan Certified Solution Architect or Master Anaplanner credentials preferred.
* Experience with Hyperion, Oracle EPM, OneStream, SAP BPC, Workday, Power BI, SQL, ETL tools, APIs, or enterprise data platforms is good to have
* Experience in banking, financial services, regulatory planning, risk, CCAR, SOX\-controlled environments, or large global enterprises.
* Strong Agile delivery experience and familiarity with SDLC, DevOps, change management, and release governance.
* Experience designing Data Hub architecture, integrations, validation routines, and controlled data flows.
* Demonstrated experience building, mentoring, and leading technical teams.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.

Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13)
description:
**Role Title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
   

  

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.


**Organizational Overview**
 The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony oversees key security functions including authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This team ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will oversee a team of seven and be a direct report into the VP, IAM Programs Leader.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 We are seeking an innovative and results\-driven leader to serve as VP, IAM Assurance Leader, responsible for leading the IAM Services Assurance function overseeing key controls across all centralized and decentralized IAM services. This role will work closely with IAM product owners and engineering teams to ensure adherence to Synchrony IAM standards and regulatory requirements without disrupting operational delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise and hands\-on experience across IAM controls, assurance operations, and identity/authentication platforms (e.g., Active Directory, LDAP technologies, Beyond Identity, and related IAM services). As a strategic leader, you will guide teams, enable cross\-functional collaboration, and drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness, reporting, and automation of IAM controls—particularly in critical areas such as logical access, authentication assurance, privileged access oversight, and control evidence for SOX/PCI and other regulatory obligations. You will blend technology insight with program management discipline to ensure success in execution and delivery, including the creation and modernization of assurance reporting capabilities and the automation of control remediation where appropriate.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Create and Maintain Strategic Roadmaps: Develop and execute multi\-year roadmaps to drive innovation, strengthen security posture, meet regulatory requirements, and streamline IAM operations—specifically for IAM assurance capabilities, control monitoring, and evidence automation.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships across Security Operations, Technology Teams, Governance, Operational Risk, and Internal Audit, ensuring program alignment, audit readiness, and the ability to clearly demonstrate IAM control effectiveness to stakeholders and regulators.
* Risk and Progress Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and organizational risks while regularly reporting blockers, corrective actions, and program milestones to executive leadership; ensure timely remediation of control gaps and recurring defects.
* Solution Design \& Automation: Lead and contribute to designing technical solutions for complex automation use cases, driving operational efficiency and scalability—especially automation to detect, track, and remediate IAM control defects.
* Program Integrity: Ensure standards, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and officially maintained for audit and compliance requirements; recommend updates to IAM standards based on security threats, regulatory expectations, and industry trends.
* Performance Tracking: Define, implement, and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure program maturity and overall effectiveness, including assurance coverage, control pass rates, remediation SLAs, defect recurrence, and reporting timeliness/accuracy.
* Assurance Operations Leadership: Lead assurance activities to track, validate, and remediate key logical access and authentication controls across centralized IAM services (e.g., Active Directory, Oracle LDAP, Beyond Identity) and decentralized implementations as applicable.
* Assurance Reporting Platform Ownership: Manage and evolve the IAM assurance reporting platform(s) used to monitor adherence to Synchrony standards, control design, and operational effectiveness; ensure reporting is accurate, resilient, and audit\-ready.
* Agile Partnership with Product Owners: Partner with IAM product owners and delivery teams using Agile methodologies to prioritize and implement control improvements, balancing risk reduction with service stability and customer impact.
* Control Evidence \& Audit Support: Ensure the organization can efficiently produce high\-quality evidence for SOX, PCI, and other examinations; proactively address audit issues with root\-cause correction and sustainable control improvements.
* Documentation \& Enablement: Oversee creation, maintenance, and review of operational process documentation and end\-user/training materials needed to support consistent execution of IAM assurance activities.
* Problem Resolution: Independently resolve technical challenges while escalating issues with clarity when necessary.
* Perform other critical duties or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading multiple IAM service products (e.g., authentication, privileged access, identity governance) and driving outcomes across both centralized and distributed service models.
* Minimum 5 years of experience developing and improving IAM service processes and reporting on IAM service key controls (design and operating effectiveness).
* Minimum 3 years leading operations or assurance teams, including continuous monitoring, issue management, and control remediation.
* At least 2 years working with Agile methodologies in roles such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Technical Lead.
* Minimum 2 years of people management experience, leading teams of 2\+ engineers or contractors.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of IAM directory services, such as Active Directory, LDAP, Oracle LDAP, or similar.
* Experience with assurance reporting, control monitoring dashboards, and/or metrics platforms used to track compliance and remediation status.
* Hands\-on experience with Security Control Design and Security Assurance Operations, including defining controls, validating operating effectiveness, and driving remediation.
* Hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux Server Access Administration and access security.
* Experience supporting or integrating IAM platforms and processes such as ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, privileged access tooling (e.g., Bomgar/BeyondTrust), and authentication technologies (e.g., RSA Authentication Manager or equivalents).


**Skills**
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for effective cross\-team collaboration and executive reporting, including the ability to translate technical risk into business impact.
* Strategic thinker able to develop and articulate long\-term program visions and actionable roadmaps.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in complex environments.
* Proactive problem solver with the ability to navigate ambiguity and escalate appropriately.
* Strong analytical and clear\-thinking skills; ability to interpret control results, identify root causes, and drive durable corrective actions.
* Customer\-oriented mindset and ability to reduce friction for product teams while improving assurance outcomes.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Proven experience leading large\-scale IAM initiatives, including program design, execution, and cross\-functional collaboration in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a track record of creating and executing long\-term strategic roadmaps.
* Strong ability to manage risk and complexity, navigate roadblocks, and drive corrective actions effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage teams while building partnerships across business units and fostering alignment to organizational goals.
* Strong commitment to providing outstanding customer experiences; ability to balance control compliance with minimal operational disruption.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and flexibility to change directions quickly while maintaining delivery discipline.
* Experience with the process of creating, maintaining and reviewing operations process \& end user training documentation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, Active Directory, Bomgar/BeyondTrust privileged access, Unix LDAP, and RSA Authentication Manager (or comparable tools).
* Experience working in highly regulated industries (Finance, Healthcare, Government), particularly enterprise\-level security in a financial institution.
* Familiarity with compliance standards such as SOX, PCI, FFIEC, GDPR, HIPAA, or NIST cybersecurity frameworks, including NIST 800\-63 and logical access control expectations.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or relevant IAM\-focused certifications.


**Eligibility Criteria**
 BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.

Job Title
   

  

 Sr. Structural Project Engineer
   

  

**Job Description**
**Structural Engineer \| Pune \| Full\-time**
 The Structural Engineer is expected to independently manage steelwork design, detailing, estimation, and coordination activities for airport projects, while contributing to process improvements and technical standards. The position requires strong technical expertise in steel structures, a proactive approach to problem\-solving, and a commitment to quality, safety, and project objectives. You will act as a subject matter expert in steelwork solutions, ensuring compliance with codes and customer requirements, and supporting project execution with strong technical and organizational skills.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead and oversee the design, detailing, coordination, and approval of structural steelwork solutions for medium\-to\-large airport, parcel, and industrial projects.
* Act as the primary technical authority for steelwork engineering, ensuring alignment with customer requirements, contractual obligations, project objectives, and company standards.
* Review contractual requirements and technical specifications during sales, bidding, and engineering phases to ensure compliant and cost\-effective steelwork solutions.
* Support bidding and proposal activities through steel tonnage estimation, budgeting, supplier evaluations, structural analysis, connection design, and Tekla model development.
* Manage and coordinate steelwork activities with internal teams, clients, suppliers, fabricators, consultants, and external engineering partners.
* Provide technical guidance and support to site installation teams to ensure steelwork execution complies with applicable codes, standards, project specifications, and site conditions for both greenfield and brownfield projects.
* Prepare and review design calculations, engineering deliverables, drawings, models, technical documentation, and project submissions.
* Perform technical reviews, risk assessments, and quality checks of critical structural elements to ensure engineering excellence and project compliance.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement optimization opportunities throughout the design, fabrication, and installation phases to improve cost, quality, constructability, and schedule performance.
* Develop practical and innovative solutions for design modifications and engineering challenges while minimizing project cost and schedule impacts.
* Support supplier engagement activities, including quotation reviews, technical evaluations, and negotiations related to steelwork scope.
* Assess claims, variation orders, and engineering changes, providing recommendations based on technical and commercial impacts.
* Mentor and support junior engineers by sharing technical knowledge, providing guidance, and promoting engineering best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by enhancing steelwork processes, standards, methodologies, and quality practices across projects.
* Ensure compliance with international design codes, industry standards, quality management requirements, and company procedures.
* Adhere to occupational health, safety, security, environmental, and quality requirements in all project activities.

* Bachelor’s degree in civil/ Structural.
* 5\-9 years of experience in structural engineering, preferably in steelwork.
* Advanced proficiency in 2D and 3D design and detailing software, such as AutoCAD, Revit, Staad Pro, Ram Connection, and Tekla Structures.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft O􀆯ice applications, particularly Excel and Word.

* Knowledge of material flow systems, such as airport baggage handling systems and cargo systems, is considered an advantage.
* Excellent stakeholder management, interpersonal, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary and global teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to assess technical risks, identify issues, and develop effective engineering solutions.
* Structured, organized, and methodical approach to engineering and project delivery.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and contributing actively within a team environment.
* Strategic mindset with a proven ability to drive process improvements, technical innovation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Flexible and adaptable work style with strong workload management and prioritization skills in a dynamic project environment.
* Fluent in written and spoken English.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**How We Work**

* Technical Leadership: Provide guidance and mentorship to development teams, ensuring high\-quality deliverables Serve as a SPOC to the L3 inhouse / vendor development team and coordinate all development and testing activities. Help development team to understand the error causes on production environment
* Review and get technical feasibility validation of the technical design provided by L3 for the change requests.
* Ensure adoption of Scrum in the development process. Also ensure DevOps is adopted within the team efficiently
* Work on roll\-back scenarios and identify cases where roll\-backs are necessary


 Release Management

* Proven experience in designing and deploying Planisware for large\-scale organizations, particularly in product or project management. Familiarity with enterprise architecture and software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies
* Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
* Ensure technical documentation is kept up to date by the development team
* Proactively identify and implement procedures to streamline the build process which may drive the development and maintenance of an automated build process
* Periodically reports performance metric dashboard for releases handled. Communicate release details and schedules to the Domains as required


**Essential Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field
* 10\+ years of overall support/development experience, of which 5 \+ years on Planisware.
* Planisware Certification – Specialist OR Expert
* 4\+ years in Change and Release Management
* 3 to 4 years of experience building on Web apps / Desktop Apps using technologies like React, Angular, Java ASP.NET, etc.
* Good understanding of consuming APIs through Single Page Application (SPA).
* Good exposure to database technologies like Oracle, MS SQL Server, etc.


**Key competencies**

* Experience working on multiple releases/projects as a subject matter expert and as a technical leader. Should have worked on complex projects that require expertise across multiple disciples and environments

* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum/Kanban environment

* Experience of providing overall process improvements adopting to the release process

**Other Skills And Abilities**

* Open to travel abroad and in India

**About You**

* 5\+ years of experience successfully implementing or managing Workday, Oracle, SAP, PeopleSoft, Ultimate Software, Kronos or similar projects at a senior or executive level


**Other Qualifications**
* Working experience with at least one of the following business areas: Human Resources, Payroll, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Financials

* Demonstrated leadership skills and experience with high\-level stakeholders. Ability to engage at C\-Level

 **APJ shift** 
 hours to support our APJ Customers.
   

  

 Candidates will be expected to participate in our 24x7 program.

 Candidates need to be able to travel weekly for customer onsite visits and events up to 50% of the time.
   

  

 Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.
   

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work.  Project Delivery

 Commercial Awareness

 Skills and Experience

 Key Performance Indicators

 At IBM Finance \& Operations, we are the backbone of IBM’s transformation driving efficiency, transparency, and smart decision\-making across the business. Our teams provide the insight and discipline that guide strategy, ensure financial strength, and enable IBM to invest in innovation and growth. Working in Finance \& Operations means combining analytical skills with collaboration and curiosity. You’ll partner with colleagues across functions and geographies, using data, technology, and process excellence to create solutions that improve performance and deliver measurable impact. IBM offers continuous learning, career development, and a culture that values diverse perspectives. Join us and be part of a global team that keeps IBM moving forward, while building your own future in a dynamic and evolving environment.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 The Associate Project Manager \- Technical is responsible for following general instructions and working with minimal supervision to prioritize work and meet deadlines.
   

  

 The role exercises judgment when working on routine and semi\-routine project assignments and resolves issues of limited to moderate complexity.
   

  

 The role is responsible for managing and leading small\-scale projects or portions of larger projects and collaborates with team members to ensure successful project execution.
   

  

 Manage and lead small\-scale projects or project components from inception to completion, ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, budget, and successful sprint execution.
   

  

 Develop project documentation, including project plans, schedules, and status reports.
   

  

 Identify and resolve project issues of limited complexity, escalating as necessary.
   

  

 Support project team members by providing guidance on project activities and deliverables.
   

  

 Facilitate project meetings, ensuring clear communication of objectives, decisions, and action items.
   

  

 Track and report project metrics, KPIs, and progress against milestones.
   

  

 Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with key stakeholders to promote project success and buy\-in.
   

  

 Communicate project updates and recommendations to project stakeholders and management.
   

  

 Apply agile methodologies to promote continuous improvement and iterative project delivery.
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Complex Project Delivery: Experience with managing large\-scale projects, ensuring delivery of solutions for complex IT, business, and client requirements, and applying techniques for planning, tracking, change control, and risk management.
* Contract Management: Experience with managing complex business outsourcing contracts, including establishing and maintaining effective relationships with clients and subcontractors.
* Strategic Risk Management: Exposure to applying strategic risk taking and risk management skills to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with complex projects.
* Team Leadership: Experience with leading project teams, providing day\-to\-day direction, and establishing effective communication plans with team members and clients.
* Business Analysis: Experience with analyzing business challenges, applying strategic innovative thinking for insights, and developing solutions to complex business problems.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Complex IT Solution Delivery: Exposure to delivering solutions for complex IT, business, and client requirements, including experience with managing large\-scale projects and applying techniques for planning, tracking, change control, and risk management.
* Business Outsourcing Contract Management: Experience with managing complex business outsourcing contracts, including establishing and maintaining effective relationships with clients and subcontractors.
* Strategic Risk Assessment: Exposure to applying strategic risk taking and risk management skills to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with complex projects.

title: PMO Sr. Program Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Senior Program Manager will facilitate and lead strategic initiatives for large multi\-faceted projects which may be customer/division specific or company\-wide. Provides management and guidance to multi\-functional project teams and/or other Project or Program Managers. Manages and enhances customer relationships. Provides full accountability for project budgets, schedules, project management, and performance requirements for enterprise level projects.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Ensures all program requirements and/or objectives are correctly gathered, understood and properly translated for execution.
* Builds teams to address the project goals and objectives for multiple and/or enterprise\-level projects.
* Collaborates with customer (internal or external) from requirements gathering through product acceptance stages.
* Aligns the program team to customer needs by establishing milestones, goals, and objectives based on input from all functional areas and stakeholders within the enterprise project.
* Reviews project schedules with functional project managers and project coordinators assigned to projects.
* Provides guidance and motivation to project teams to successfully achieve project goal and corporate initiatives.
* Communicates project objectives in terms of overall strategic business objectives.
* Serves as interface with customers, vendors, stakeholders and project sponsor(s).
* Devises creative solutions to critical customer and user needs.
* Manages development of project plans with focus on achievement of project goals and corporate initiatives, including project\-specific Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s) or metrics.
* Monitors projects' Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and manages the work within scope, quality, time and cost constraints.
* Obtains and summarizes current project information and milestone status versus project performance baseline.
* Drives project/program tasks to completion in accordance with the project schedule.
* Coordinates the efforts of the team to develop an integrated project plan and risk analysis with action plans to mitigate the risks.
* Manages resource capacity and time tracking allocated to enterprise\-level project.
* Performs Financial Management and analysis of costs for enterprise\-level projects and programs including Capital Expenditures Requests (CER’s) travel, training, resources allocation and other project related costs.
* Forecasts project budget and labor needs for current and future site needs.
* Remains accountable for overall program success \- including cost, schedule, quality, and scope management.
* Holds team accountable for individual and team results.
* Balances the cost, schedule and time\-frames against the enterprise level project requirements.
* Reports project status, issues and implemented solutions as well as evaluations and assessments of the results.
* Provides leaders with updates, including greatest opportunities for improvement.
* Recognizes potential problem areas against the plan and identify and implement alternative solutions.
* Identifies best cost solutions to reduce cost by streamlining processes and systems (i.e. modification of responsibilities or consolidation of tasks, elimination of non\-value added processes, or complete re\-engineering of processes and systems).
* Provides key stakeholders with regular project performance status, variances to plan, and identification of corrective actions (if required).
* Participates in the exchange of ideas and information within the department and with other Jabil facilities to ensure best practices are shared throughout the company.
* Drives continuous improvement through trend reporting analysis and metrics management.
* Demonstrates a commitment to customer service; anticipate, meet and exceed expectations by solving problems quickly and effectively, making customer issues a priority.
* Coaches others through difficult decision making situations.
* Designs and facilitates training related to implementation of enterprise initiatives.
* Engages and collaborates with customers within Jabil to obtain greater understanding of customer needs.
* Drives relevant, concise and effective communication through a variety of mediums.
* Designs clear and consistent messages for a variety of diverse audiences, ensuring relevance and effectiveness of delivery.
* Works closely with communications, stakeholders , and management to stay informed of important company information to evaluate and measure program effectiveness and impact on the business.
* Complies with and follows all procedures within the company security policy.
* Leads teams across different regions and time zones.
* Travels to different regions depending on program requirements.
* Identifies and understand interdependencies across multiple sites and functional areas.
* May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.


**Job Qualifications**
**KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS**
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent required
* Must be adept at navigating the diversified landscape with respect to country cultures, company divisions and internal hierarchies
* Proficiency in use of personal computers, Microsoft Office products (Excel, Word and PowerPoint) and e\-mail skills required
* Proficiency in use of project management software (Microsoft Project, Celoxis, Smartsheets, etc) is required


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree required, Masters Degree Preferred
* Minimum of 8 years work\-related experience required in project management or related discipline.
* Minimum of 8 years work\-related experience in regulated industries.

title: Release Manager
description:

* End\-to\-End Ownership and Accountability \- Take full ownership of the release and program lifecycle – including product definition, prototyping, development, continuous integration, testing, production release and post\-release evaluation\-managing scope, schedule, cost and quality from product definition to product release
* Strategic Planning and Execution – Develop and execute strategic forecasts and plans, set clear milestones to keep the releases and programs on track
* Leadership and Cross\-Functional Collaboration – Provide leadership to multi\-functional and cross\-functional teams, aligning stakeholders and influencing teams without direct authority to achieve shared goals.
* Customer\-Centric Product Delivery – Partner product management, and engineering teams to ensure solutions and releases address customer needs.
* Risk Management and Problem Solving – Proactively identify, assess, prioritize, and mitigate program risks that may impact delivery commitments.
* Quality, Productivity, and Continuous Improvement – Ensure every release and program meets the highest standards of quality, productivity, efficiency and reliability. Drive initiatives, continuous and measurable improvements ensuring each release and program is better than the last.
* Communication and Stakeholder Engagement – Communicate clear, actionable regular updates to stakeholders and all levels of the organization on details of release/programs, progress, risks and resolutions.
* Compliance and Standards – Ensure compliance with corporate, environmental and legislative requirements, safety and cybersecurity.
* Post Release/Program Evaluation – Lead post release/program evaluations to identify success and areas for improvement.


**Who You Are:**
 You thrive in high\-pressure, high\-visibility environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity. You collaborate effectively across diverse teams, building alignment and driving programs from concept through successful delivery. By actively listening, seeking diverse perspectives, and fostering open communication, you enable informed decision\-making and shared commitment to outcomes. You are passionate about delivering innovative products and orchestrating complex launches, taking initiative to achieve meaningful business impact.

* Working experience in leading complex product development programs in a global setup.

* To have demonstrated ability to plan/manage budget, resources, work activities, and risks/mitigations working on New Product Development (NPD) projects.

title: Manager - Civil Hydro PSP Projects
description:
**About Company**
 Founded in 2011, ReNew, is one of the largest renewable energy companies globally, with a leadership position in India. Listed on Nasdaq under the ticker RNW, ReNew develops, builds, owns, and operates utility\-scale wind energy projects, utility\-scale solar energy projects, utility\-scale firm power projects, and distributed solar energy projects. In addition to being a major independent power producer in India, ReNew is evolving to become an end\-to\-end decarbonization partner providing solutions in a just and inclusive manner in the areas of clean energy, green hydrogen, value\-added energy offerings through digitalisation, storage, and carbon markets that increasingly are integral to addressing climate change. With a total capacity of more than 13\.4 GW (including projects in pipeline), ReNew’s solar and wind energy projects are spread across 150\+ sites, with a presence spanning 18 states in India, contributing to 1\.9 % of India’s power capacity. Consequently, this has helped to avoid 0\.5% of India’s total carbon emissions and 1\.1% India’s total power sector emissions. In the over 10 years of its operation, ReNew has generated almost 1\.3 lakh jobs, directly and indirectly. ReNew has achieved market leadership in the Indian renewable energy industry against the backdrop of the Government of India’s policies to promote growth of this sector. ReNew’s current group of stockholders contains several marquee investors including CPP Investments, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Goldman Sachs, GEF SACEF and JERA. Its mission is to play a pivotal role in meeting India’s growing energy needs in an efficient, sustainable, and socially responsible manner. ReNew stands committed to providing clean, safe, affordable, and sustainable energy for all and has been at the forefront of leading climate action in India.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 The Civil Manager Maharashtra Projects holds end\-to\-end responsibility for all development\-stage activities across PSP project sites in Maharashtra — from initial site surveys and geotechnical investigations through in\-situ testing, regulatory permissions, and project development planning — until the commencement of construction. The role demands equal command over field investigation management, multi\-agency permitting, and structured development planning, underpinned by fluency in Marathi for all government and regulatory engagement specific to Maharashtra.
   

  

**Key Sector Exposure – Hydro \& Pumped Storage**
* End\-to\-end development stage management for hydropower or PSP projects prior to construction commencement.
* Site survey and investigation management — topographic, geomapping, GIS, aerial, and geophysical surveys.
* Geotechnical drilling programs and in\-situ field testing (SPT, PLT, vane shear, permeability, RQD).
* Permitting and approvals management for site access, survey, drilling, and investigation activities.
* Project development plan and pre\-construction readiness documentation
* Coordination with Maharashtra state government, Revenue, Forest Department, MPCB, District Administration, and regulatory bodies.


****Key Responsibilities****
* Plan, mobilize, and manage all site survey activities — topographic surveys, geo\-mapping, GIS\-based terrain analysis, aerial/drone surveys, and hydrological field data collection across all Maharashtra PSP sites.
* Direct and oversee all geotechnical investigation programs including borehole drilling, core logging, test pitting, geophysical surveys, and sub\-surface data collection; supervise drilling contractors and ensure quality of bore logs and sample chain of custody.
* Plan and execute the complete suite of in\-situ tests — SPT, PLT, plate load, field permeability; witness all field tests and review results for integration into Geotechnical Investigation Reports with the help of designated geologist.
* Lead preparation of the Project Development Plan covering all pre\-construction milestones — site layout, approach road and construction infrastructure planning, utility identification, schedule for regulatory submissions and FID\-readiness checklist.
* Obtain all permissions and NOCs required to conduct survey, investigation, and drilling activities — including site access permissions, land entry permissions, forest entry permits, Tree Cutting Permissions, and WRD authority clearances — coordinating directly with Maharashtra government bodies in Marathi.
* Liaise with Maharashtra Revenue Department, District Collector, Sub\-Divisional Officer, Forest Department, Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB), MSEDCL, GSDA, Gram Panchayat, and all relevant state and local bodies for regulatory compliance and field\-level approvals.
* Draft, translate, and respond to official correspondence with Maharashtra government authorities in Marathi; attend compliance hearings, inter\-departmental meetings, and inspection visits as the organization's Marathi\-language representative.
