* Establish and maintain third\-party risk management standards \& key controls that enable effective risk mitigation and implement robust processes for assessing and monitoring third\-party risk controls and performance.
* Serve as a trusted SME in third\-party risk management, providing expert guidance and support to business units in the selection, onboarding and management of third\-party relationships.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive risk reporting framework that offers senior management and stakeholders insights into third\-party risk exposure.
* Partner with leads across Business Areas and Functions to mature the operating model, framework delivery and governance to allow M\&G to better manage risks associated with a complex supply chain including global outsourcing.


**Accountabilities/Responsibilities**
**Commercial Function Collaboration:**
* Work closely with the commercial function to align third\-party risk management practices with business goals and objectives.
* Ensure that third\-party contracts and agreements reflect appropriate risk considerations.


**Policy Compliance Oversight:**
* Monitor and enforce compliance with third\-party risk policies and standards across the organization.
* Conduct regular assessments and audits to identify and address compliance gaps.


**Risk Reporting Enhancement:**
* Prepare and present regular risk reports and dashboards.


**Vendor Relationship Management:**
* Collaborate with business units to establish and nurture strong relationships with key third\-party vendors.
* Oversee ongoing vendor performance monitoring and risk assessments.


**Regulatory Awareness:**
* Stay up\-to\-date with regulatory changes and industry trends pertaining to third\-party risk management.
* Ensure that the organization's policies and practices remain fully compliant with relevant regulations.


**Third Party Risk Management**
* Lead maintenance and oversight of the associated policy, standards and standard operating procedures (SOPs) throughout programme implementation and on an ongoing basis.
* Lead the maturing of the governance framework to enable data\-driven insights and oversight of Third Party Risk to the M\&G plc Board of Directors, subsidiary Boards, senior management and other key stakeholders.
* Support engagement with group entities on international Third Party Risk Management and Outsourcing regulatory rules and guidance, incorporating these where relevant into group policies, standards, methods and tooling.
* Deliver strategic projects and ad\-hoc tasks to support both change and run of a maturing TPRMO framework.
* Take part in joint TPRMO testing with critical third parties.
* Facilitate any required TPRMO controls testing, assurance and / or audit examination requirements.


**Key Stakeholder Management**
**Internal**
* Business areas and their relevant third party risk management / commercial management teams
* International teams across M\&G plc group
* Finance (Commercial)
* Enterprise Technology
* Human Resources
* Risk and Internal Audit


**External**
* Members of professional Third Party Risk and Procurement organizations and Industry forums
* External suppliers / outsource partners


**Knowledge, Skills, Experience \& Educational Qualification**
**Knowledge \& Skills:**
* Profound knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards pertaining to third\-party risk management.
* Strong knowledge of third party risk management and outsourcing best practices including relevant financial services regulations Proficiency in risk assessment methodologies, data analysis, and reporting tools.
* Confident and effective at advising and briefing at all levels, including senior stakeholders
* Ability to work independently within a defined remit, managing schedule and objectives with minimal oversight
* Strong communication skills displayed through confident interpersonal and presentation abilities
* Ability to work within a wider team and collaborate effectively across teams, functions and geographies
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Communication and interpersonal abilities, with a proven track record of effective cross\-departmental collaboration.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and the capacity to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Coaching and training of people


**Experience:**
* 10yrs\+ experience in risk management (including Technology and/or security).
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in third\-party risk management or a related role within the financial services industry.
* Experience in delivery of third party risk management and outsourcing oversight programmes
* Experience in third party due diligence, risk assessments and financial health monitoring
* Experience using third party management and third party risk management tooling and interest in supporting the maintenance of tools, supporting data sets
* Awareness of TPRMO regulatory expectations
* Experience of delivering training and awareness campaigns
* CTPRP certification will be an advantage


**Qualification:**
* Graduate in any discipline / Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Risk Management, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).


 We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M\&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: Program Manager
description:
**Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader**
 We pioneer technology for mobility experience that matter to people.
   

  

**Your Mission, Roles And Responsibilities**
 The Program Manager is responsible for leading the program in all aspects, from program award until 6 months after Start of Production. He/she is the guarantor of customer satisfaction in conjunction with the achievement of program Quality, Cost and Delivery objectives, while ensuring profitability throughout the entire program lifecycle. The main missions of the role are to:
   

  

* Develop strong relationships and manage the ongoing negotiations with the customer as the official Faurecia representative
* Prepare and submit the RFQA to Management if relevant
* Liaise with the Program Controller, build the initial Business Plan, define the Program investment scheme, and release investments in compliance with controlling procedures; take economical responsibility for all deviations from initial requirements
* Launch and monitor the Program: track progress by updating Business Plan, Program Dashboard and Budget Reports, and by leading reviews of program steps and results
* Conduct Risk/Opportunity analysis, and develop and implement appropriate action plans
* Arbitrate any conflicts with the customer on financial and/or technical issues
* Staff, manage and co\-ordinate a cross\-functional program team, define team members' objectives and assignments
* Create a "Program Management culture" by ensuring processes defined in the Faurecia Program Management System (PMS) are applied at all steps, and by developing synergies between all actors involved in the program
* Organize communications throughout the program lifecycle
* Ensure smooth program transfer from Development Centre to Production Plant
* Organize key program information to ensure Program continuity and to contribute to knowledge management


**Your profile and competencies to succeed**
* Bachelors degree minimum, Masters degree, ideally in engineering highly preferred
* Minimum 4 years of experience (in an industrial environment and/or with product experience a plus)
* Results orientation
* Strong communication and negotiation skills
* Conflict management skills : ability to prevent and solve conflicts
* Ability to work in a matrixed organization
* Good knowledge of Program standards, tools and methods
* Fluent in English and in the customer language
* Ability to establish, develop, lead and unite a team
* Strong financial knowledge (incl. building and following a Business Plan)
* Problem solving techniques
* Strategic and analytic capabilities
* Planning and organizing abilities


**What We Can Do For You**
* At Forvia, you will find an engaging and dynamic environment where you can contribute to the development of sustainable mobility leading technologies.
* We are the seventh\-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development.
* We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast\-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count.
* We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in\-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world)

* Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net\-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1\.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy.


**Why join us**
 FORVIA is an automotive technology group at the heart of smarter and more sustainable mobility. We bring together expertise in electronics, clean mobility, lighting, interiors, seating, and lifecycle solutions to drive change in the automotive industry.
   

  

 With a history stretching back more than a century, we are the 7th largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in 43 countries. You'll find our technology in around 1 out of 2 vehicles produced anywhere in the world.
   

  

 In June 2022, we became the 1st global automotive group to be certified with the SBTI Net\-Zero Standard. We have committed to reach CO2 Net Zero by no later than 2045\.
   

  

 As technological innovation and the need for sustainability transform the automotive industry, we are ideally positioned to deliver solutions that will enhance the lives of road\-users everywhere.

title: Program Manager – Healthcare Technology
description:
**Company Overview** 
**:** 




  





 Blue Pearl HealthTech (BPHT) is a Pune\-based healthcare technology company and the maker of eLABAssist, a cloud SaaS platform serving over 2,000 pathology and radiology laboratories across India and internationally. We build end\-to\-end laboratory information and management systems — from patient registration and sample tracking through to reporting, billing, quality assurance, and compliance — for labs ranging from single\-site diagnostics centres to large multi\-location corporate chains.
 



  





**Role Overview :** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced
 **Program Manager** 
 to lead end\-to\-end delivery of our next\-generation healthcare platform. The role will coordinate product, engineering, QA, infrastructure, implementation, and compliance, ensuring delivery timelines, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder alignment are effectively managed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




  





**Program planning and governance** 



* Own and maintain the master program plan across all workstreams — product, engineering, QA, infrastructure, implementation, and compliance — with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and risk registers.
* Define and run the cross\-workstream delivery cadence: weekly engineering and product syncs, fortnightly risk reviews, and monthly executive and stakeholder status reports.
* Maintain a live dependency map across parallel workstreams and proactively identify and resolve blockers before they affect the critical path.
* Produce board\-ready and investor\-level program status updates — translating technical and delivery detail into business\-level progress and decision points.



  





**Delivery and execution** 



* Drive delivery accountability across engineering squads and functional leads — without line management authority — through clear plans, transparent tracking, and structured escalation.
* Manage scope, schedule, and quality trade\-offs with product and engineering leadership, ensuring that changes are assessed for impact across the full program before being accepted.
* Own the risk register: identify, assess, and track program\-level risks across technical, resource, regulatory, and commercial dimensions, with mitigation plans for each.
* Coordinate QA and release management for major milestones — ensuring readiness gates are defined, tracked, and met before customer\-facing releases.



  





**Stakeholder management** 



* Serve as the primary coordination point between the co\-founders, engineering leads, product management, the business analyst team, and external implementation and sales partners.
* Manage relationships with enterprise customer accounts during platform onboarding and migration — coordinating implementation timelines, go\-live plans, and escalation resolution.
* Coordinate with international sales and implementation partners as the platform expands into new geographies, managing SOW governance, delivery timelines, and partner accountability.



  





**International expansion coordination** 



* Coordinate multi\-region deployment and compliance requirements across target markets including India, Africa, Southeast Asia, and the United States — working with legal, data, and engineering to track regulatory calendars.
* Manage localisation and market\-specific customisation workstreams — ensuring locale, language, currency, and regulatory requirements are captured, prioritised, and delivered on schedule.
* Onboard and manage international implementation partners: structured partner onboarding, SOW governance, delivery accountability, and escalation management.



  





**Process and documentation** 



* Establish and maintain delivery processes, templates, and documentation standards for the program — including decision logs, RAID logs, sprint planning artefacts, and release notes.
* Drive continuous improvement of delivery practices across the engineering and product teams, identifying bottlenecks and introducing lightweight process improvements without adding bureaucracy.



  
 



**Whar we are Looking for** 

 :
 




  




* 8\+ years of program or project management experience, with at least 3 years managing large, multi\-workstream technology programs — platform rebuilds, SaaS product development, or enterprise ERP/LIMS implementations — not just feature\-level delivery.
* Demonstrated experience managing programs that span multiple functional teams (engineering, product, QA, infrastructure, customer success) with accountability for the overall plan rather than one workstream.
* Direct experience coordinating software rollouts across international geographies — managing localisation requirements, regulatory compliance calendars, and partner delivery accountability across at least two countries or regions.
* Strong stakeholder management: comfortable engaging with co\-founders and senior leadership, enterprise customers, and external partners in the same week, with communication calibrated to each audience.
* Excellent written communication: capable of producing a detailed dependency map for an engineering lead and a clean, concise board update for investors from the same underlying program data.
* Solid command of program management tools and practices: Gantt/milestone planning, RAID logs, dependency tracking, risk management, and release governance — applied pragmatically, not ceremonially.



  





**Preferred experience** 

 :
 




  




* Prior experience in healthcare IT, diagnostics, laboratory information systems, hospital information systems, or adjacent regulated software — with exposure to compliance frameworks such as NABL, NABH, ISO 15189, HIPAA, or CAP.
* Experience managing ISV\-to\-enterprise go\-to\-market programs — coordinating sales engineering, customer implementation, and post\-go\-live support as a unified delivery motion.
* Familiarity with cloud\-hosted SaaS product delivery on Azure or AWS — understanding infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and multi\-tenant architecture at a conceptual level sufficient to track dependencies and risks.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, or equivalent program management certification is a plus, though demonstrated delivery track record is weighted more heavily.



  





**How you work** 

 :
 




  




* You are comfortable operating in ambiguity — building structure and clarity where none exists, without waiting for someone else to define the framework first.
* You default to written, asynchronous communication and treat clear documentation as a professional habit, not an afterthought.
* You escalate early and with options — bringing problems with proposed mitigations to leadership, not just status updates.
* You hold people accountable without friction — clear, consistent, and direct without being adversarial.
* You are genuinely curious about the domain and motivated by the complexity of building software that serves clinical and diagnostic workflows.

title: Staff Technical Program Manager
description:
**About Kaseya**
 Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.
   

  

 Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
   

  

 Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders \- and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
   

  

 We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better \- a product, a process, a career \- you'll fit right in.
   

  

 At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Kaseya is looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to lead high\-impact, cross\-platform technical programs that span multiple SaaS products, engineering organizations, and business functions. In this role, you will operate as a force multiplier for engineering and product leadership, driving execution rigor, dependency management, and delivery predictability across complex initiatives such as platform integrations, modernization efforts, reliability improvements, and enterprise\-scale launches. This role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, executive communication, and the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Program Leadership \& Delivery
   

  

* Own and drive end\-to\-end execution of large, cross\-functional technical programs impacting multiple Kaseya products and platforms
* Translate company\-level priorities into clear program plans, milestones, success metrics, and delivery commitments
* Actively manage scope, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, and operations teams
* Ensure programs are delivered with high quality, security, and reliability standards appropriate for MSP and enterprise customers


 Technical \& Architectural Partnership
   

  

* Partner closely with engineering leaders and architects to understand system design, platform constraints, and technical risks
* Drive alignment on architecture decisions, sequencing, and integration strategies, especially across acquired products
* Develop technical fluency across Kaseya's SaaS platforms, APIs, data flows, and cloud infrastructure


 Stakeholder \& Executive Communication
   

  

* Serve as the single\-threaded owner for program health, communicating clearly with senior engineering, product, and executive leaders
* Produce crisp executive\-level updates that highlight progress, risks, mitigation plans, and decision points
* Facilitate decision\-making across organizations with competing priorities and limited resources


 Operational Excellence \& Scale
   

  

* Establish scalable program management frameworks, operating rhythms, and tooling to support Kaseya's growth
* Identify systemic execution gaps and drive improvements in planning, dependency management, and delivery predictability
* Mentor and influence other TPMs, helping raise the bar for technical program management across the organization


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Engineering Program Management, or equivalent roles in SaaS or cloud\-based software environments
* Strong technical foundation with the ability to engage deeply in architecture, APIs, data, and cloud\-native systems
* Proven experience leading multi\-team, multi\-product programs with significant technical and organizational complexity
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority in a fast\-paced, matrixed organization


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working on platform integration, M\&A integration, or large\-scale SaaS modernization initiatives
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), distributed systems, and enterprise\-grade security requirements
* Experience supporting B2B, IT management, security, or MSP\-focused products
* Strong working knowledge of Agile and hybrid delivery models
* Prior experience mentoring TPMs or acting as a program leader across multiple initiatives


**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

 As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead cross\-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. Our market\-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries.
   

  

 We help organizations in their efforts to achieve regulatory and legal compliance and transform their departments to add greater value to the business. We combine highly specialized skills focused on process, risk and controls to produce transformative insights. Our team
   

  

* Enable profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing “heart of the business” operations.

* Familiarity with Service now ticket system

 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Technical Architect \& Salesforce Manager** 
 to join our consulting team. In this hybrid role, you will act as a
 **billable Technical Architect** 
 on active client engagements—designing robust, scalable Salesforce solutions—while simultaneously
 **managing and mentoring a team** 
 of skilled Salesforce Developers to ensure technical excellence, professional growth, and successful project delivery.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills from a technology perspective, including a foundational understanding of how to leverage AI development tools to optimize delivery cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background. You are able to lead and motivate a team of highly capable individuals and help them meet their targets while enabling their growth.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Requirements**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, guiding delivery teams on the effective use of AI\-assisted tooling to maintain velocity and quality
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, encouraging the use of AI coding assistants to enforce best practices
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Ability to understand a project and debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to assist in interpreting logs and isolating bottlenecks
* From time\-to\-time, participate in activities such as technical landscape discovery, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations

title: Manager / Assistant Manager - Estimation
description:
**About Zeeco**
 Zeeco is a global leader in advanced combustion and environmental solutions, delivering innovative technologies for the refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, power, pharmaceutical, and allied process industries. Our portfolio includes process burners, power burners, boiler burners, duct burners, thermal oxidizers, flares, vapor recovery systems, incinerators, and combustion control systems. With engineering and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Zeeco provides customized combustion solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and environmental compliance.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Zeeco is seeking an experienced
 **Senior Estimation Engineer** 
 with
 **10 to 15\+ years of experience** 
 in preparing techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of combustion equipment, burner management systems, instrumentation, mechanical equipment, and project costing.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for reviewing customer enquiries, interpreting technical specifications, coordinating with engineering and procurement teams, obtaining vendor quotations, developing accurate cost estimates, and preparing competitive technical and commercial proposals for global projects.
   

  

 Candidates with either a
 **Mechanical Engineering** 
 or
 **Instrumentation \& Control Engineering** 
 background and extensive experience in industrial combustion equipment are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**RFQ \& Technical Review**
* Review customer RFQs, ITBs, specifications, datasheets, PFDs, P\&IDs, burner schedules, and other project documents.
* Evaluate process requirements, fuel characteristics, combustion duty, control philosophy, emissions, and applicable design standards.
* Identify technical clarifications, scope gaps, deviations, and commercial risks before proposal submission.


**Estimation \& Costing**
* Prepare accurate techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner packages.
* Develop Bills of Materials (BOM) covering burners, fuel trains, BMS/CCS, PLC/HMI, instrumentation, valves, electrical, mechanical, and bought\-out items.
* Estimate engineering, fabrication, assembly, testing, logistics, commissioning, and documentation costs.


**Vendor \& Proposal Management**
* Obtain and evaluate vendor quotations for technical compliance, pricing, and delivery.
* Coordinate with procurement to optimize vendor selection and project costing.
* Prepare technical and commercial proposals, including cost sheets, assumptions, exclusions, and deviations.


**Engineering Coordination**
* Coordinate with Mechanical, Process, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, and Manufacturing teams to validate technical and commercial inputs.
* Review engineering deliverables such as P\&IDs, GA drawings, wiring diagrams, and instrument schedules to support accurate estimation.


**Cost Optimization \& Bid Support**
* Identify value engineering opportunities and cost\-effective technical solutions while ensuring compliance with customer specifications.
* Support customer clarification meetings, bid evaluations, negotiations, and project handover following order award.


**Estimation Database**
* Maintain estimation databases, standard costing, historical pricing, and vendor cost records to improve estimation accuracy and proposal competitiveness.


**Technical Expertise**
**The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of:**
**Combustion Systems**
* Process, Boiler, Power, and Duct Burners
* Low NOx, Ultra Low NOx, Gas, Oil, Dual\-Fuel, and Multi\-Fuel Burners
* Burner sizing, fuel selection, combustion principles, and emissions requirements


**Fuel Train \& Mechanical Systems:**
* Fuel gas and liquid fuel trains
* Pressure regulators, safety shut\-off valves, control valves, vent valves, filters, and strainers
* Burners, dampers, registers, skid\-mounted systems, piping, and fabricated assemblies


**Instrumentation \& Controls:**
* Burner Management Systems (BMS) and Combustion Control Systems (CCS)
* PLC/HMI\-based control systems
* Flame scanners, ignition systems, pressure, temperature, and flow instrumentation
* Control valves, actuators, and combustion safety interlocks


**Estimation \& Proposal Engineering:**
* Interpretation of RFQs, P\&IDs, datasheets, burner schedules, and technical specifications
* Preparation of Bills of Materials (BOM), vendor enquiries, techno\-commercial evaluations, and detailed cost estimates
* Cost optimization, value engineering, and proposal preparation for industrial burner packages


**Codes \& Standards:**
 Working knowledge of applicable combustion and industrial standards, including
 **NFPA 85/86** 
 ,
 **API** 
 ,
 **ASME** 
 ,
 **IEC** 
 , and
 **ISA is preferred.**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Instrumentation \& Control Engineering.
* 10–15 years of experience in estimation, proposal engineering, or applications engineering for industrial combustion systems.
* Experience working with burner OEMs, combustion equipment manufacturers, EPC companies, or industrial heating solution providers is preferred.


**Preferred Industry Background**
* Industrial Burner Manufacturers
* Combustion Equipment OEMs
* Boiler Manufacturers
* Process Heater OEMs
* Furnace Manufacturers
* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical
* Refining
* Power Generation
* EPC Organizations
* Industrial Heating Equipment Manufacturers


**Desired Competencies**
* Strong techno\-commercial acumen.
* Excellent understanding of combustion systems and process heating applications.
* Ability to interpret complex customer specifications and translate them into accurate cost estimates.
* Strong analytical and cost modelling skills.
* Excellent negotiation and vendor management capabilities.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
* Ability to manage multiple enquiries with tight bid submission deadlines.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Self\-driven with a strong focus on accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement.

title: Deployment Project Manager
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Deployment Project Manager is a key role within the Litmus Customer Success team and is responsible for ensuring the successful deployment of Litmus products into our customer’s environments.
   

  

 The Deployment Project manager will create and manage implementation schedules, manage issues and risks and develop and execute project communication strategies for our client\-facing projects.
   

  

 The Deployment Project manager will also, at times, have oversight of third\-party partners who will be performing work as sub\-contractors to Litmus.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Manages Litmus projects using a waterfall methodology through Initiation, Planning, Execution and Close Phases
* Develop and maintain schedules, manage issues and risks for customer facing deployments of Litmus products
* Manage scope of the project and identify / issue change requests due to changing requirements
* Prepare project management reports for Account Management and customer stakeholders
* Develop statement of work in conjunction with sales and account management teams, including estimates for project effort
* Perform cost analysis for ongoing projects and recommend actions to preserve profit margin as needed
* Hold project status meetings, take and publish minutes, ensure timely communication with customers
* Leads handover to support of any deployment projects as part of the Closedown phase


****What You’ll Bring****
**Must Have**
* Proven track record and experience implementing software and infrastructure projects in a manufacturing environment
* Excellent communication, negotiation and organizational skills
* Experience using Wrike or other Project Management software
* Experience performing in a customer facing / interactive role
* Self\-starter and able to work independently as well as in a team environment


**Nice to Have**
* PMP or other professional project manager designation is preferred
* Background in manufacturing software or infrastructure is an asset
* Enjoys solving problems
* Enjoys staying up to date on new technology and continually learning new things
* Able to adapt to change in a fast\-paced environment.

Organization Overview:
   

  

 We are a dynamic, global, and diverse Organization, with a presence in over 60 Countries; covering all front post execution Operations teams including product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative \& Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of Capital Markets products and services including Fixed Income (FX, Rates, Credit, Muni, Cash and Derivatives) where Citi is consistently a dominant top 3 player in the market, Equity (Cash, Derivatives, Prime Brokerage, Futures, Listed Derivatives, FXPB) where Citi has a significant growth program to continue to build out its capabilities and services; and Syndicates where we support both FI and EQ new issues and IPOs.
   

  

 We take pride and are passionate about our People and our culture. We are invested in our People and their development. We are transforming and simplifying our operating model, creating an exciting environment which encourages diversity of thought and inclusion.
   

  

 Our Operations groups are core to the success of the Markets business and have significant impact across the lifecycle of a trade. We partner extensively with a range of internal stakeholders including Front Office Sales and Trading Desks, Compliance, Legal, Finance and HR; alongside having significant interaction with our external client base, playing a key role in the overall client experience. We have a Client relationship group, dedicated to overseeing the Organizational service performance and strategic partnership for our top tier client base, where we play a key role in supporting our global clients to ensure they have a first\-class experience when doing business with Citi.
   

  

 Our Business Intelligence and Process Re\-engineering group works alongside our Operations teams delivering automation solutions to solve for operational challenges. We partner with Citi’s innovation labs to drive optimization, and overall play a pivotal role in enabling us to transform to achieve our target operating model.
   

  

 Our Technology partners develop and implement a wide range of applications that support the Operations, Change, Design and Implementation groups in providing innovative products and solutions. We have re\-imagined how to provide technology and service in our domain through the alignment of our team vision, culture, and aggressive retirement plan for legacy applications and adoption of a micro\-based containerized cloud environment. We encourage our people to create, explore and be adventurous whilst taking measured risk, adopting safe practices to protect the firm. Data lineage and optimization is core to how we develop our eco system. We are growing our capabilities using artificial intelligence, natural language processing and machine learning.
   

  

 Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast\-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and adopt a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to reduce risk through the continuous evaluation of our controls; to protect our clients, the firm, and our reputation.
   

  

 We work closely with our external global peers, partners, and regulators, and play an integral part in leading an agenda at the forefront to optimize and streamline processes and drive strategy across our industry.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 The Markets Process Engineering team has been formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank, to design and deliver a multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment change execution and a market leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process re\-engineering and low code application development.
   

  

 The Futures and OTC Clearing franchise is an agency business providing trading and clearing capabilities across 40\+ exchanges to our clients and proprietary lines of business such as Equities, Rates, Commodities, FX and Prime D1\. The business is embarking on a strategic re\-engineering of its platforms. This is a multi\-year initiative, moving to real\-time computation, and with ambitious goals to design and deliver a more robust, strategic, well controlled end state for Futures and OTC Clearing Operations.
   

  

 We are recruiting for a Project/Business Analyst to help lead the delivery of strategic initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global, and dynamic change management team, delivering a major Tier 1 program.
   

  

 The role will work in partnership with the Futures and OTC clearing business, global operations teams, technology and downstream areas such as finance and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The core responsibilities of the Project Manager and Business Analyst include but not limited to the following:
   

  

* Develop and manage project plans, define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage project lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring that project deliverables are met and proper evidence provided.
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, developing and implementing effective mitigation and contingency plans.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project charters, requirements, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Facilitate and lead project meetings, including kick\-offs, status updates, working groups and governance forums, to ensure clear and consistent communication among all project participants.
* Conduct business and data analysis to document business and operational processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop and maintain detailed process maps, use cases to support business and functional requirements
* Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for improvement, and assist in designing enhanced workflows
* Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that developed solutions meet business requirements and are fit for purpose.
* Prepare senior level presentations to communicate project updates
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance and other functions to ensure successful project implementation.


**Qualifications:**
* Project Management and Business Analysis experience
* Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) Regulatory Reporting knowledge is a plus
* 2\-3 years operations experience (preferably in banking)
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Strong ability in use of Microsoft Applications (PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Word, Excel, Access)
* Proficient with the project life cycle (Waterfall \& Agile)
* CAPM, PMP, PgMP and/or MBA are a plus
* Developed communication and diplomacy skills required to persuade and influence others; may negotiate with external parties.


**Role Overview:**
 The role we are recruiting for is a hybrid Business Analyst / Project Manager role aligned to the Equities business. You will be part of the Futures \& Derivatives Clearing (FDC) and Equities Operations Program Execution Team, a key component of the Markets Ops Transformation organization. The team drives strategic transformation and delivers Target Operating Models for FDC and Equities Operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Manage end\-to\-end projects from defining scope, milestones and deliverables with stakeholders to ensuring successful, on\-time delivery meeting business needs.
* Planning \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive project documentation, including charters, business requirements, plans, and risk/issue logs.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Monitor project progress, resources, and risks, identifying and escalating issues promptly and providing timely, clear updates and presentations to all stakeholders, including senior management.
* Process Optimization: Lead business analysis efforts, clarify requirements, and drive the development and implementation of innovative, efficient processes for Equities Operations.
* Risk \& Compliance: Apply robust risk management practices and ensure regulatory compliance to protect the firm's reputation.
* Team \& Collaboration: Drive resource planning and foster strong cross\-functional collaboration across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and other departments.
* Strategic Initiatives: Champion change management and undertake additional strategic projects/tasks as required.

description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Lead, Business Continuity Manager (APAC Location)**
**Location**
 Bangalore / Pune
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Lead, Business Continuity Management (APAC Location) is responsible for the development, implementation, governance, testing, and continuous improvement of Business Continuity Management (BCM).
   

  

 This role serves as the primary APAC focal point for technology continuity planning while partnering with global technology teams, infrastructure organizations, cybersecurity, enterprise risk management, business units, and regional regulators. The incumbent will ensure that critical technology services can withstand, respond to, and recover from disruptive events while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regional regulatory requirements.
   

  

 The role requires balancing regional execution with global alignment, ensuring APAC\-specific risks, regulatory obligations, and operational requirements are effectively incorporated into the enterprise resilience framework.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Continuity Strategy \& Governance**
* Lead the APAC Technology Business Continuity Program.
* Develop and maintain regional technology continuity and resilience strategies aligned with global frameworks.
* Ensure regional BCM practices are aligned with enterprise risk management standards and global technology policies.
* Establish governance forums, metrics, reporting, and executive dashboards for continuity and resilience programs.
* Support annual reviews of continuity policies, standards, procedures, and recovery strategies.


**Continuity Planning \& Preparedness**
* Develop, maintain, and govern Technology Business Continuity Plans (BCPs).
* Ensure recovery plans exist for critical platforms, infrastructure services, applications, and technology processes.
* Coordinate Business Impact Analyses (BIA) and risk assessments across APAC technology functions.
* Assess dependencies involving third\-party vendors, cloud service providers, and critical technology partners.
* Maintain inventories of critical services, applications, recovery strategies, and recovery objectives.


**Disaster Recovery \& Resilience Testing**
* Coordinate disaster recovery testing programs across APAC technology teams.
* Manage tabletop exercises, simulation exercises, crisis management drills, and failover testing activities.
* Validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
* Track remediation of gaps identified through testing and post\-incident reviews.
* Produce executive summaries and lessons\-learned reports following exercises.


**Operational Resilience**
* Support identification and mapping of Important Business Services (IBS) and technology dependencies.
* Assess resilience vulnerabilities across people, process, technology, facilities, and third\-party ecosystems.
* Assist in establishing impact tolerances and resilience performance measures.
* Support enterprise operational resilience initiatives and regional regulatory requirements.


**Crisis Management \& Incident Response**
* Support technology crisis management and major incident response activities.
* Participate in regional command centers during significant incidents.
* Coordinate communications, issue escalation, decision tracking, and recovery governance during disruptions.
* Facilitate post\-incident reviews and corrective action plans.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as the primary APAC liaison between global BCM teams and regional technology leadership.
* Partner with:
+ Infrastructure Engineering
+ Cyber Security
+ IT Operations
+ Technology Risk Management
+ Enterprise Risk
+ Corporate Services
+ Business Units

* Provide guidance and coaching to technology teams regarding continuity planning requirements.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.


**Professional Certifications (Preferred)**
* CBCP (Certified Business Continuity Professional)
* MBCI (Member, Business Continuity Institute)
* ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
* PMP
* ITIL


**Experience**
* 8\-12 years of experience in Business Continuity Management, Disaster Recovery, Operational Resilience, Technology Risk, or Technology Operations.
* Minimum 3\-5 years managing continuity programs within a technology organization.
* Experience supporting large\-scale global technology environments.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are currently seeking a software engineering manager to join the Alternatives Data Management (ADM) team. Our team is building AI\-powered data products and workflow solutions that unlock transparency, efficiency, and insight in private market investments. You’ll lead a full\-stack team of engineers and collaborate closely with Product and Design to deliver client\-facing features that will set us apart from our competitors.
   

  

 Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Manage a small team of frontend and backend engineers that will grow as you do
* Own technical design and implementation for some of your projects to set a good example for the ICs
* Work with platform teams to deliver features with consistent capabilities
* Drive the career growth of your direct reports
* Stay up to date on industry trends, such as AI tooling, that can make the team more effective
* Collaborate with ADM engineering and product leads in the US, UK and India to drive team\-wide process improvements and best practices


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* Minimum 10\+ years of software engineering experience
* Minimum 2\+ years managing software engineering teams
* Full\-stack, product engineering experience a big plus
* React experience a plus
* Strong experience with Python OR Java will be required
* Experience with AWS will be highly preferred


***Important Note: This role requires working from our Pune office 3 days a week (hybrid work model)***
**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

 As a Field Engineer, Team Lead you will serve as a player\-coach — guiding a team of field engineers while personally executing the most complex, mission\-critical technical work yourself.  You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite — from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white\-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI\-driven tooling. At the same time, you will develop your people\-management skills: providing daily guidance, coordinating work allocation, and turning the vision set by leadership into reality while keeping your team aligned to our core processes. This role combines a forward\-deployed delivery model with hands\-on technical depth and functional leadership of a high\-performing engineering team.

* Architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
* Manage the team's work allocation and coordinate activities across simultaneous client engagements, ensuring results are delivered on schedule and in collaboration with cross\-functional partners
* Guide the team through issue resolution, proactively escalate blockers, and maintain alignment with client and internal stakeholders
* Design and implement production\-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time\-to\-value, and enable operational scale
* Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
* Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics

* Identify and drive opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and automation for greater team efficiency, and develop internal frameworks and best practices that accelerate delivery
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence the platform roadmap
* Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value


**Who You Are**

* Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production\-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines; strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture
* Data Platforms: Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks; proficiency in SQL and experience working with large\-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases
* Pipelines \& Automation: Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations; familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM\-driven automation solutions
* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi\-asset class portfolios
* Engineering Practices: Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices
* Leadership: A solutions\-driven, player\-coach mindset — able to balance hands\-on delivery with coordinating a team, providing feedback, and a commitment to growing your people\-management skills
* Communication: Outstanding communication skills with the ability to conduct technical presentations and translate complex concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Organization: Highly organized with attention to detail, able to prioritize and context\-switch across simultaneous client engagements and deliver results that may impact schedules and costs
* Mindset: Independent, adaptable, and entrepreneurial with a strong work ethic, a bias for action, and a passion for client impact; thrives in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments while maintaining high\-quality standards

title: Cyber Risk Governance & Reporting
description:
Join us as a Cyber Risk Governance \& Reporting at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Cyber Risk Governance \& Reporting, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Managing a large and complex portfolio of cyber risk governance, regulatory assurance, and reporting activities across regions, entities, and stakeholders
* Performing data analysis and preparing responses to support Barclays’ continued compliance with regulatory obligations across the globe
* Strong working knowledge of cyber security, risk management, and regulatory expectations, with the ability to translate complex technical content into clear, non\-technical outputs for senior stakeholders and regulators
* Using collaboration, workflow, and reporting platforms such as SharePoint, trackers, and MI dashboards to generate insights, support decision\-making, monitor delivery, and highlight emerging risks
* Supporting tracking, oversight, and resolution of control issues, including those raised by 2LOD and internal assessments that could impact regulatory compliance
* Driving group\-wide GRC assessments, reporting, and compliance to the Barclays Control Framework to identify control enhancements aligned to regulatory requirements
* Enabling proactive risk identification through thematic analysis, MI\-driven insights, continuous improvement initiatives, and effective stakeholder engagement


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Strong experience in Governance, Risk \& Control within large enterprises, preferably within financial services or a similarly regulated environment
* Ability to generate, analyse, and interpret cyber security MI using qualitative and quantitative techniques to identify trends, risks, control gaps, and improvement opportunities
* Experience with audit oversight, control frameworks, internal assessment activities, and regulatory requirements, including the ability to support evidence\-based assurance and issue remediation
* Ability to translate technical cyber risks into business\-relevant insights, reporting narratives, and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across cyber, technology, risk, compliance, audit, and senior leadership teams.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, and communication, as well as job\-specific technical skills in cyber risk governance, regulatory engagement, reporting, and quality assurance.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune, India.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To provide independent and balanced advice and counsel to senior stakeholders through problem identification, solving and decision making practices.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Provision of strategic advice to Group Executives to support the decision\-making process of business challenges and opportunities.
* Development and implementation of strategic advisory incentives to grow and optimise the bank’s operations, through market research and analysis.
* Collaboration with various stakeholder groups to identify the appropriate strategic direction type to meet the needs of Barclays clients and investors.
* Development of financial models to support strategic recommendations and transactions through financial data analysis, financial projects and considering the financial impact of transactions.
* Management of transactions, negotiations, transaction structure development and post\-transaction integration.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders to maintain client relationships, and develop new relationships to identify opportunities.
* Identification of industry trends, maintain peer benchmarking and developments related to strategic advisory services by attendings conferences, participating in training and conducting market research.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: SAP Platform Lead
description:
**Application Deadline:** 
 6 September 2024
 



**Department:** 
 Program Optimus
 



**Location:** 
 India
   

  




**Description**
*Great People Work Here*
 Transforming WHAT we do and HOW we do it.
   

  

 We are embarking on a huge program of global business transformation enabled by the implementation of a new global technology solution. The delivery and embedding of this technology solution across our highly successful and highly de\-centralized business will change the way we work forever, enabling greater data insight, simplification of processes and ways of working and creating greater collaboration across the business.
   

  

**Purpose:** 
 The Platform Leader is accountable for delivering the strategic technical design, implementation, and long\-term vision for applications and integrations under the Optimus program. This role involves strategic leadership, working closely with key stakeholders to align platform initiatives with business goals, ensuring that the technology landscape supports current needs while also preparing for future growth and innovation. In partnership with our SI partner, AMS Partner, SAP, and the business technology services (BTS) architecture team, this role oversees planning and delivery across Basis, Infrastructure, Security, technical development, integrations, and overall technical architecture of our global SAP solution. The role demands a blend of strategic thinking, hands\-on leadership, problem\-solving, and good relationship management.
   

  

**Scope:** 
 This is a global role covering TwiningsOvo (TwO) international businesses. The role will require occasional international travel.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide strategic leadership in the implementation of platforms and applications under the Optimus program, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and long\-term strategy.
* Oversee the development and execution of the platform and integration strategy, ensuring that platforms are secure by design, scalable, and able to support the future growth of the business.
* Respond strategically to new and emerging security threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring proactive rather than reactive responses.
* Develop and implement policies for managing applications and platforms securely, including identity and access management, patching, and disaster recovery, with a focus on future\-proofing the technology landscape.
* * * Provide the strategic implementation of iPaaS platforms that deliver any\-to\-any integration across heterogeneous applications in hybrid landscapes worldwide.
* Foster innovation and strategic thinking in the development and building of a centralized, well\-documented API estate, promoting reuse and supporting API versioning and lifecycle management.
* Shape the current and target state of application and integration architectures, defining and managing strategic standards, guidelines, and processes to govern integration and future expansion.
* Ensure the seamless transition from the program to BAU of all platforms, applications, and integrations, establishing comprehensive strategic processes and comprehensive documentation to support long\-term sustainability.
* Collaborate strategically with AMS teams to analyze operations and develop cost\-effective strategies to reduce manual tasks and improve the overall health and performance of underlying platforms.
* Stay ahead of technology trends and explore the strategic application of existing, new, and emerging technologies to enable new and evolving business and operating models.
* Develop strategic partnerships with other leaders to implement new platforms, develop custom solutions, and modernize integrations to support the company’s strategic direction.
* Maintain and develop strategic relationships with key technology suppliers, ensuring that their roadmaps align with our long\-term strategic goals.
* Manage financial budgets strategically, ensuring that investments are aligned with the long\-term health and strategic direction of the platforms and applications.
* **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
	+ At least 10 years of hands\-on experience working with SAP technologies in a large\-scale, multi\-platform systems environment.
	+ Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategic plans for platform security and emerging security threats.
	+ Expertise in future\-focused SAP tech stack/platforms: i.e., SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud ALM, IAG, Ariba, IBP, etc.
	+ Proven strategic leadership in developing and delivering large\-scale IT projects across multiple geographies and platforms.
	+ Good strategic planning skills with experience in shaping and delivering long\-term technical roadmaps aligned with business goals.
	+ Demonstrated growth in influencing and executing strategic decisions that balance business needs and technical capabilities.
	+ Proven experience in implementing strategic partnerships and maintaining third\-party relationships to support business and technical strategies**Benefits**
	+ Monthly phone bill maximum reimbursement limit is Rs.3000\.
	+ Annual check\-up for employee and spouse including Doctor consultation \- reimbursement up to INR 15,000\.
	+ Medical Insurance 5 lakhs Flat Coverage.
	+ PF and Gratuity.
	+ Long Service Policy.
	+ Life Term Policy,
	+ Monthly Broadband Bill Reimbursement \- Rs.2000 or on actual whichever is lower.

title: Factory Manager- Aluminium Facades
description:
Production Manager – Aluminium Façades
 



**Company:** 
 McCoy Architectural Systems Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
 Chakan, Pune
 



**Department:** 
 Aluminium Façades Manufacturing
 



**Reports to:** 
 Plant Head / Factory Manager
 



**Direct reports:** 
 Production Engineers, Supervisors, Operators, Assembly Technicians and Helpers
 



**Functional coordination:** 
 Engineering, PPC, Quality, Procurement, Stores, Maintenance, EHS and Site Installation
 



 This role is tailored for an architectural façade manufacturing environment involving aluminium façade systems, skylights and related building\-envelope products.
 



 Job purpose
 



 To plan, manage and control aluminium façade production so that products are manufactured safely, accurately, economically and according to approved drawings, project schedules and quality requirements.
 



 Key responsibilities
 



 Production planning and execution
 


* Execute production plans issued by PPC.
* Manage cutting, CNC machining, routing, drilling, assembly and packing activities.
* Ensure correct production sequencing for stick, unitised, semi\-unitised, curtain\-wall and cladding systems.
* Allocate manpower, machines, tools and workstations.
* Monitor daily production against planned quantities and project milestones.
* Coordinate production priorities with Engineering, PPC and Project Management.



 Technical and drawing control
 


* Ensure production uses only approved and revision\-controlled drawings.
* Verify profiles, accessories, glass, brackets, fasteners, gaskets and sealants before production.
* Review fabrication drawings, cutting lists, BOMs and assembly instructions.
* Identify design or constructability issues before production starts.
* Coordinate technical clarifications with the Engineering Department.



 Quality control
 


* Ensure correct profile dimensions, cutting accuracy, drilling positions and assembly tolerances.
* Control joint preparation, corner crimping, screw fixing, sealing and gasket installation.
* Ensure correct use of approved sealants, tapes, fasteners and accessories.
* Coordinate first\-piece inspection and in\-process inspection with QA/QC.
* Reduce rejection, leakage risk, scratches, dents, colour mismatch and rework.
* Support mock\-ups, performance testing and customer inspections.



 Manpower and shop\-floor management
 


* Supervise production supervisors and shift teams.
* Maintain skill matrices and arrange operator training.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, overtime and labour productivity.
* Establish standard work instructions for repetitive operations.
* Promote 5S, visual management and continuous improvement.



 Material and inventory control
 


* Coordinate with Stores for timely availability of aluminium profiles and accessories.
* Control material identification, batch traceability and project\-wise segregation.
* Minimise profile wastage and damage during handling.
* Ensure proper protection of finished components before dispatch.
* Report shortages, excess consumption and material discrepancies.



 Equipment and maintenance
 


* Ensure proper operation of saws, CNC machines, routers, drilling machines, crimping machines and assembly tools.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance with the Maintenance Department.
* Report machine breakdowns and production losses promptly.
* Ensure calibration and condition of measuring instruments and jigs.



 Safety and compliance
 


* Enforce PPE, safe material handling and machine\-guarding requirements.
* Ensure safe use of sealants, solvents, adhesives and cutting equipment.
* Conduct toolbox talks and shop\-floor safety inspections.
* Stop unsafe work and report incidents or near misses.
* Maintain good housekeeping and emergency access routes.



 Dispatch and site coordination
 


* Coordinate packing and dispatch in the required installation sequence.
* Ensure identification marks, labels, packing lists and project documents are complete.
* Support site teams with installation feedback and technical clarification.
* Analyse site complaints and implement corrective actions in production.



 Key performance indicators
 


* Production plan achievement
* On\-time project dispatch
* Labour productivity
* First\-pass quality acceptance

**Role Purpose**
 As an
 **Critical** 
**Incident Manager (CIM)**
